notes: Positive: explicit or elliptical requests for commit message text (subject, body, draft, improve, rewrite). Includes hypothetical requests and squash-mode triggers. Negative: requests for staging, executing the commit, rebasing, splitting commits, or non-commit git operations. Edge: combined intents (draft and commit) — skill only produces text, not execution; squash for a branch — different protocol but same skill.

cases.query: What should the commit message say for the changes I just staged
Draft a commit subject and body for this diff

Genera un commit message para los cambios staged
Rewrite this commit subject to match Conventional Commits
Mensaje para el squash de esta branch vs main
cases.notes: Squash workflow — different protocol but same skill (see references/squash-mode.md).

cases.query: Critique my commit message and propose improvements
Run git commit -am 'fix typo' for me
cases.notes: Skill produces text only; never executes the commit.

cases.query: Split this commit into three smaller ones

cases.notes: Knowledge question, not a message-authoring request.

cases.notes: Skill produces the text; the commit execution part is out of scope and should be deferred to the user.
